big_case.notes: Paid petition seeking error correction of an unpublished Fourth Circuit per curiam affirming summary judgment for a private employer on a COVID-19 vaccine religious-accommodation claim under Title VII after Groff, with a Rule 56(d) expert-disclosure dispute attached. The post-Groff health-and-safety undue-hardship question recurs in lower courts, but this vehicle is fact-bound, the respondent waived response, there were no amici, and the Court denied without noted dissent. Stakes beyond the parties are low.
